'''House Dianatkhah''' is one of the known [[Nobility|Noble]] [[House]]s of [[Saldaea]], and was a previous royal house of the nation.

Its only known member was King [[Nikiol Dianatkhah]], who was known as one of the nation's greatest kings, but his fatal flaw was being a drunkard.

As the house has not been mentioned as of {{ne|998}} or later, it may be extinct, as the throne later passed to other houses such as [[House Kazadi]], and later [[House Bashere]].
